output.title: IP addresses in Certificate commonName now go to ipAddresses
output.content: The fix changes how certificates whose `commonName` holds an IP address are handled: the IP moves from the DNS subjectAlternativeName list to `ipAddresses`. The environment uses cert-manager.io/v1 Certificate in its manifests and has the certificates.cert-manager.io [v1] CRD installed. Inspect the Certificate manifests for any `commonName` containing an IP address, and check whether downstream consumers depend on the old DNS SAN entry. The summary does not show the actual commonName values, so this is only a review prompt.
